links.outcome: Prognostic performance of locked MMAI algorithm on external multi-trial cohort (PCSM association)
links.effect: MMAI per SD increase strongly associated with PCSM (HR 1.40, 95% CI 1.30-1.51, p<0.0001) in 3167 patients from four STAMPEDE trials
links.quote: The MMAI algorithm (per SD increase) was strongly associated with PCSM (hazard ratio [HR] 1·40, 95% CI 1·30-1·51, p<0·0001).

screen.reason: This is an external validation study of a locked commercial multimodal AI algorithm (ArteraAI Prostate) using retrospective trial data from four phase 3 STAMPEDE trials to assess its prognostic value for prostate cancer-specific mortality.
